proposals.before: Shigu (great-great-grandson of Zhao Zu; Eastern Capital Defender).
proposals.after: Shigu (great-grandson of the Bright Ancestor; Eastern Capital Defender).
proposals.reason: Chinese 曾孫 means great-grandson; great-great-grandson would be 玄孫 (as used for Chongcheng).

proposals.before: Chongcheng (great-great-great-grandson of Zhao Zu; Commander of the Martial Army).
proposals.after: Chongcheng (great-great-grandson of the Bright Ancestor; Commander of the Martial Army).
proposals.reason: Chinese 玄孫 is great-great-grandson (son of a 曾孫), not great-great-great-grandson.

proposals.before: Ang (born Wute; Associate Councilor of State and Prince of Yan).
proposals.after: Ang (born Wute; Associate Councilor of State and Prince of Yun).
proposals.reason: 鄆王 is Prince of Yun; Yan would be 燕.

decisions.after: Shigu (great-grandson of Zhao Zu; Eastern Capital Defender).
decisions.reason: s0810 昭祖曾孫 makes Shigu Zhao Zu's great-grandson, so 'great-great-grandson' is wrong; keep the established 'Zhao Zu' for 昭祖 rather than substituting 'the Bright Ancestor.'

decisions.after: Chongcheng (great-great-grandson of Zhao Zu; Commander of the Martial Army).
decisions.reason: s0815 昭祖玄孫 is great-great-grandson, not great-great-great-grandson; retain 'Zhao Zu' for 昭祖 instead of the proposal's 'Bright Ancestor' rename.
s0240 鄆王 is Prince of Yun; Yan would be 燕, so replacing 'Prince of Yan' with 'Prince of Yun' is accurate.

label.en: Associate Councilor of State and Prince of Yan
Associate Councilor of State and Prince of Yun

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows English 'Prince of Yan' came only from misreading 鄆 as 燕; the office label must read Prince of Yun while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
